Seedance 2 AI — Initial Release

- Generate cinematic, high-motion AI video clips from text prompts, reference images, or both.
- Seamless connection and authentication with ByteDance's Seedance 2 API, including free trial token support.
- Supports various modes: text-to-video, image-to-video, style transfer, easy export, credits checking, and state reporting.
- Automatic backend event handling, error handling, and smart API routing for upload, generation, export, and balance queries.
- Outputs high-quality video in multiple formats (mp4, mov, avi, webm, gif, etc.).
- Clear, user-friendly setup and status updates; hides technical details during use.
